entries.original_title: Paper page - IQuest-Q1: Advancing Foundation Capabilities for Agentic CLI Systems
entries.subtitle: IQuest-Q1 is a sparse model with 320B total parameters and 15B activated, trained for agentic coding and broader capabilities.
entries.reject_reason: IQuest-Q1 is a named model, but its developer IQuest is not a tracked entity and the tracker only hosts its paper page.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Deep Search in Real-World Web Environments
entries.subtitle: OpenDS-World is a live-web benchmark for multi-step search agents, and its results show a gap between frontier models and human performance.
entries.reject_reason: The live-web agent benchmark is research, but the page does not identify a tracked entity as its creator.

entries.original_title: OlmoEarth v1.3: State-of-the-art embeddings for the whole planet
entries.subtitle: OlmoEarth v1.3 offers satellite data embeddings for the whole planet and a browser tool to explore maps, with no sign-in required.
entries.reject_reason: OlmoEarth v1.3 is an Ai2 model announcement hosted on Hugging Face, but Ai2 is not a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Editing Images into Reusable Layers via Compositional Edit-Prior Distillation
entries.subtitle: LayerEditor combines guided image editing with reusable RGBA layers, allowing users to change target areas while preserving other image content.
entries.reject_reason: LayerEditor is new image-editing research, but its authors are not identified as a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Deep Fusion Memory: A Chunk-Level Parametric Memory for Large Language Models
entries.subtitle: Deep Fusion Memory places learned memory inside language-model processing, aiming to reduce retrieval overhead on knowledge-intensive tasks without online search.
entries.reject_reason: Deep Fusion Memory describes a new method, but using tracked companies' models in experiments does not make it their research.

entries.original_title: Paper page - LaLa-World: Scaling Latent World Models with Natural Language Actions
entries.subtitle: LaLa-World learns from simulation, robot, image, and video data to support planning by predicting future states from language conditions.
entries.reject_reason: LaLa-World is attributed to NAVER AI Lab, which is not a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - What Generation Knows: Unlocking Fine-Grained Understanding in Unified Multimodal Models
entries.subtitle: GAFU uses generation-side information to improve detailed visual understanding in multimodal models by selecting compact features for specific tasks.
entries.reject_reason: The multimodal research appears on a tracker page without an identified tracked-entity author.

entries.original_title: Cohere Model Vault: Verifiable Confidential AI Inference
entries.subtitle: Cohere details how Model Vault combines confidential computing, encrypted requests, and remote attestation to protect data during AI processing.
entries.reject_reason: The article explains how Cohere's previously launched Model Vault works without announcing a new product or research result.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Meta Expert: Cross-Layer Expert Sharing for Storage- and Retrieval-Efficient MoE
entries.subtitle: Meta Expert shares experts across model layers, reducing parameter redundancy while improving measured loss and task accuracy compared with local experts.
entries.reject_reason: The Meta Expert paper is attributed to untracked researchers, not to tracked Meta AI.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Toward Recursive Self-Improvement in Physical AI
entries.subtitle: The paper examines how systems that improve themselves could apply this approach to physical AI, where trials are costly and outcomes may be irreversible.
entries.reject_reason: The physical-AI survey comes from researchers outside the tracked entities.

entries.original_title: OpenAI and Poland’s NASK partner to advance AI safety and security
entries.subtitle: OpenAI and Poland’s NASK will work on AI safety, security, and technical research to strengthen safeguards and support digital resilience.
entries.reject_reason: The safety partnership describes planned cooperation without a concrete research result or product launch.

entries.original_title: Kazakhstan Expands Compute for Its AI Future
entries.subtitle: Kazakhstan is building AI infrastructure and local-language models, while NVIDIA’s Jensen Huang discussed the country’s AI plans with officials in Astana.
entries.reject_reason: The Kazakhstan article centers on infrastructure ambitions, meetings, and an investment rather than an AI research or product launch.

entries.original_title: Amazon OpenSearch Serverless now supports a 5-second default refresh interval
entries.subtitle: Amazon OpenSearch Serverless now refreshes search and vector collections every 5 seconds by default, making newly added data searchable sooner.
entries.reject_reason: A shorter default OpenSearch refresh interval is a minor search-service adjustment despite its possible RAG uses.

entries.original_title: Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation
entries.subtitle: Anthropic is giving its open Agent Skills standard to the Agentic AI Foundation, after adoption by more than 70 agent platforms.
entries.reject_reason: Anthropic is transferring an existing agent standard to a foundation, not announcing research, a product feature, or a model.

entries.original_title: Amazon Connect Customer now supports customizing the Customer Profiles app on the agent workspace
entries.subtitle: Amazon Connect Customer Profiles lets administrators use saved Profile Explorer layouts to show agents customer details suited to different roles.
entries.reject_reason: The Amazon Connect change is chiefly a customer-profile layout option, with AI only an optional existing widget.

entries.original_title: How to Read Data into GPU Memory in Python with NVIDIA GPUDirect Storage
entries.subtitle: The article introduces reading data into GPU memory with NVIDIA GPUDirect Storage, as datasets and AI computing needs continue to grow.
entries.reject_reason: This is a how-to article about existing GPUDirect Storage capabilities, not a new technique or launch.

entries.original_title: Open call for guest investigators in the life sciences
entries.subtitle: Anthropic invites life sciences researchers to propose 8–12-week projects using Claude, with its researchers, models, and tools provided at no cost.
entries.reject_reason: The call for life-sciences collaborators announces a program rather than a research result or product launch.

entries.original_title: Perplexity API changelog updated
entries.subtitle: Perplexity renamed the Agent API preset to effort, a name-only change that keeps models, prompts, tools, limits, and pricing the same.
entries.reject_reason: The changelog explicitly describes a naming-only API change and SDK parameter updates, not a new model or major launch.

entries.original_title: From One Card to an Ever-Changing World: The Making of KING CARD with Kling 4.0
entries.subtitle: The article describes how Kling 4.0 helped create KING CARD, a film that has reached 5 million views across social platforms.
entries.reject_reason: The article explains how an existing Kling 4.0 film was made and does not launch the model or a feature.

entries.original_title: Introducing the SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network
entries.subtitle: xAI introduced an official partner program for companies that build Grok products or services, with training, tools, and support for customer work.
entries.reject_reason: xAI's partner network is a commercial partnership program rather than a new AI product or research result.

entries.original_title: Amazon Quick Now Available in the AWS Singapore Region
entries.subtitle: Amazon Quick is now available in AWS Asia Pacific (Singapore), letting customers use its AI tools while keeping data stored and processed locally.
entries.reject_reason: Amazon Quick's Singapore-region availability adds no new agentic capability or major product launch.

entries.original_title: AWS Lambda MicroVMs is now available in 4 additional AWS regions
entries.subtitle: AWS Lambda MicroVMs expanded to 4 more Regions, bringing availability to 14 Regions for isolated execution of user- or AI-generated code.
entries.reject_reason: Availability of the existing Lambda MicroVMs product in four more regions is not a substantive AI product update.

entries.original_title: Uber brings ChatGPT Work to all employees with OpenAI
entries.subtitle: Uber is bringing ChatGPT Work to more than 30,000 employees for research, data analysis, presentations, and complex workflows.
entries.reject_reason: Uber's deployment of an existing ChatGPT product is a customer adoption story, not a new product launch.

entries.original_title: Solidigm to Discontinue Review of Potential IPO, Reaffirming Commitment to Long-Term Growth and Shareholder Value
entries.subtitle: Solidigm stopped reviewing a possible IPO because of market conditions and share-price trends, while SK hynix continues to seek ways to support growth.
entries.reject_reason: Solidigm's decision to stop reviewing an IPO is financial news, not an AI research or product development.

entries.original_title: AWS announces AWS Interconnect - last mile preview with Megaport
entries.subtitle: AWS and Megaport opened a preview service that lets customers create private AWS connections from offices, data centers, and remote sites through the console.
entries.reject_reason: AWS Interconnect is a general cloud-connectivity offering rather than an AI-focused product launch.

entries.original_title: AWS CloudFormation now simplifies stack update rollback operations
entries.subtitle: AWS CloudFormation can now force an update rollback in one operation when some resources cannot roll back automatically, restoring a deployable stack.
entries.reject_reason: CloudFormation's rollback convenience feature is not an AI product development merely because agents can use it.

entries.original_title: What FDE means at OpenAI
entries.subtitle: The article explains what forward deployed engineering means at OpenAI, but the available text gives no further details.
entries.reject_reason: An explanation of forward-deployed engineering at OpenAI is not a launch or research result.

entries.reject_reason: New games and membership purchasing options on GeForce NOW do not match the AI research, model, or product interests.

entries.reject_reason: The IAM service-reference metadata additions are unrelated to the specified AI interests.
